nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract, set to msg.sender at deployment and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address written by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
ERC20 token symbol, fixed to MONKEY in the constructor.
ERC20 token name, fixed to Monkey Island in the constructor.
Token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Internal total supply, minted entirely to the owner in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Blacklist/counterparty address; transfer reverts when to == newun and transferFrom can silently set it to the recipient.
Mapping of token holder balances mutated by constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping mutated by approve, approveAndCall and transferFrom.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership assignment, onlyOwner checks, acceptOwnership and ETH withdrawal destination.
Overflow-checked addition helper used by transfer and transferFrom.
Underflow-checked subtraction helper used by totalSupply, transfer and transferFrom.
Overflow-checked multiplication helper in the library (unused by the token logic).
Division helper with zero-divisor guard (unused by the token logic).
Sets the deployer (msg.sender) as owner.
Owner-only two-step ownership transfer that stores a pending owner.
Claims ownership; requires msg.sender == newOwner and then clears the pending owner.
Initializes symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and mints the whole supply to owner.
Owner-only setter for the newun blacklist address, enabling targeted transfer blocking.
Returns _totalSupply minus the balance held at address(0).
Public balance reader for an arbitrary address.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender; reverts when the recipient equals newun.
Sets a spender allowance from msg.sender.
Spends an allowance to move tokens; contains hidden logic that assigns newun = to when newun is zero.
Reads the remaining allowance for a spender.
Sets an allowance and then makes an external call to spender.receiveApproval, an external reentrancy vector.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, blocking plain ETH transfers to the token contract.
Owner-only function that drains the entire contract ETH balance to the caller.
Empty payable fallback of the derived contract that lets anyone accumulate ETH in the contract.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, address(this), data) executed before state is finalized.
_owner.transfer(address(this).balance) sending all contract ETH to the caller.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership writes the supplied address into newOwner.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner before writing newOwner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before promoting the caller to owner.
acceptOwnership reads and then resets newOwner to address(0).
Constructor sets symbol = 'MONKEY'.
Constructor sets name = 'Monkey Island'.
Constructor sets decimals = 18.
Constructor sets the fixed _totalSupply value.
Constructor mints the whole supply into balances[owner].
Owner-controlled transfernewun can set the newun blacklist to block any recipient.
onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender before updating newun.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply and subtracts the burned balance.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer debits and credits the balances mapping.
transfer reverts when to == newun, a censorship/blacklist hook.
transfer uses SafeMath.add for the recipient balance.
transfer uses SafeMath.sub for the sender balance.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens.
transferFrom debits from and credits to balances.
transferFrom decrements the caller allowance in allowed.
Hidden backdoor: transferFrom sets newun = to while newun is address(0), silently arming the blacklist.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.add for credit.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub for debit and allowance.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowance before calling out.
approveAndCall invokes the unsafe external callback to the spender.
The external receiveApproval call can re-enter approve/transferFrom and rewrite allowed before the caller settles state.
clearCNDAO performs the balance transfer operation.
The whole contract ETH balance is sent to the caller address (owner).
onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender before draining the balance.
The open payable fallback accumulates ETH that only the owner can sweep via clearCNDAO.
totalSupply uses SafeMath.sub.

Parameter is the credited recipient and is also silently written to newun.

Parameter is the owner key read from allowed.
Parameter is the spender key read from allowed.
Parameter is the callback target of approveAndCall.
Parameter is the allowance value and forwarded amount.
Parameter is forwarded as raw calldata to the callback.
Local variable receives the drained ETH in the unsafe transfer operation.
